name: Mr. Ashok Kumar Singh
title: Senior Consultant
experience: 35+ years before the Supreme Court of India (since 1987)
bio:
Mr. Ashok Kumar Singh is a highly accomplished Advocate-on-Record of the Supreme Court of India with an extensive and distinguished practice spanning more than three decades. He has been practicing before the Supreme Court of India since 1987 and qualified the Advocate-on-Record Examination in 1992.

Throughout his career, Mr. Singh has held several prestigious appointments, reflecting the confidence reposed in him by various governmental authorities. He served as Standing Counsel for the State of Madhya Pradesh before the Supreme Court of India for a period of ten years commencing on 18 March 1997. He was subsequently empanelled as Counsel for the State of Uttar Pradesh before the Supreme Court from 14 August 2001 onwards. In 2009, he was appointed as Standing Counsel for the Central Agency by the Government of India, and in 2015, he was appointed as Special Standing Counsel for the State of Haryana in matters concerning inter-state water disputes.

Mr. Singh has advised and represented Central and State Governments, Public Sector Undertakings, statutory bodies, corporations, multinational enterprises, and private individuals across a wide spectrum of complex legal matters. His areas of expertise include Constitutional Law, Environmental Law, Taxation, Corporate and Commercial Litigation, Civil and Criminal Law, Arbitration, and Regulatory Disputes.

Over the years, he has been associated with numerous reported judgments that have contributed to the development of jurisprudence across diverse fields of law, including constitutional, environmental, taxation, company, arbitration, civil, and criminal law. He has appeared in and successfully argued several matters involving substantial questions of law, public policy, and issues of national importance.

Known for his strategic insight, meticulous preparation, and persuasive advocacy, Mr. Singh has earned a reputation as a trusted counsel in high-stakes and complex litigation. His enduring contribution to the legal profession and commitment to excellence continue to make him a sought-after advisor and advocate before the Supreme Court of India and other judicial forums across the country.

name: Mr. Surender Kumar, IFS (Retd.)
title: Senior Consultant
experience: 33+ years in the Indian Forest Service and government advisory
bio:
Mr. Surender Kumar had a distinguished career in the Indian Forest Service spanning more than 33 years, during which he held diverse assignments including Secretary, Environment Department; Member Secretary, Tripura Bio-diversity; CEO, Indo-German Development Project; and Director, Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region.

During his tenure with the Ministry of Environment & Forests, Government of India, he contributed to the drafting of the amendment to the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, the framing of a policy for eco-tourism, and the enforcement of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES). He also represented India in the Interpol group on wildlife crime. As Secretary, Environment Department in Tripura, he introduced the ban on single-use polythene and the Noise (Pollution) Rules.

Apart from a Law degree from Delhi University, he holds a Masters in Physics and an M.Phil. in Social Sciences. He has considerable experience in corporate governance and served as MD, TRPC. He also represented the central government on the boards of the North Eastern Development Finance Corporation (NEDFi) and NERAMAC.

During his years as a bureaucrat, he was responsible for overseeing the implementation of numerous high-worth projects. He has been instrumental in drafting and vetting legislations and parliamentary reports, and has been actively involved with parliamentary committees, having headed several committees including disciplinary committees.

Mr. Kumar has ample experience in project implementation and strategizing, including budget, timeline and personnel, along with hands-on experience in dealing with and strategizing litigation on behalf of the government.
publications: Ban on single-use polythene and Noise (Pollution) Rules

name: Mr. Hem Chandra Pant
title: Senior Consultant
education: FCS (Fellow, Institute of Company Secretaries of India)
experience: 30+ years in the legal field, 20+ years with BSNL as Chief General Manager (Legal)
bio:
Mr. Hem Chandra Pant is a well qualified professional with over three decades of experience in the legal field. He is a Law graduate, a Fellow of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (FCS), and a Post Graduate in Commerce (M.Com) and Business Administration MBA (HR).

Mr. Pant has extensive hands-on experience of dealing with a comprehensive range of legal issues involving legal scrutiny and examination, drafting and vetting of various policies, deeds, documents, agreements and contracts. While working with BSNL as Chief General Manager (Legal) for over two decades, he advised the top management and business vertical heads on a broad range of areas including Corporate Laws, Capital market regulatory and Securities laws, contracts, Telecom regulatory & business laws, arbitration, employment & service laws, anti-corruption laws and compliance mechanisms.

He has handled and managed high-stake litigation on behalf of BSNL involving direct and indirect taxes, local taxes, contracts, employment and service matters. He has been a member of the management teams constituted for the purposes of joint ventures; drafting, vetting and negotiation of shareholders agreements; take-overs, mergers and acquisitions; demergers and disinvestment. He has also been actively involved in rendering legal opinions, offering comments on various draft legislations referred by the Administrative Ministry, and attending meetings of various Parliamentary Committees.

name: Mr. Devender Kumar Sharma
title: Senior Consultant
bio:
Mr. Devender Kumar Sharma is a practicing advocate with over 32 years of experience in managing and strategizing complex legal issues. Over his long and illustrious career, he has handled high-profile cases involving Land Acquisition, Contracts, and Corporate Disputes.

He is an expert in property due diligence and documentation, and handles high-value property deals on a regular basis. He also advises clients on asset management.

name: Ms. Namrata Khandelwal, C.A.
title: Senior Consultant
experience: 20+ years in Business, Financial and Project Management
bio:
Ms. Namrata Khandelwal is a Chartered Accountant with more than 20 years of experience in Business, Financial and Project Management, Accounting, and liaison and coordination with Government officials at all levels (both State and Central), with a proven track record of accomplishing the desired results with high integrity, work ethics and a keen eye for detail.

She handled the ICAI Accounting Research Foundation (ICAI ARF), the research arm of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, for more than 7 years. She has executed several projects for Government Ministries such as Indian Railways, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, Ministry of Rural Development, and Ministry of Panchayati Raj, as well as other regulators and authorities like the Office of the Comptroller & Auditor General of India. She is an expert at multi-tasking, handling multiple projects simultaneously with teams ranging from 5 to 100+ professionals.

name: Ms. Shobhana Takiar
title: Senior Consultant
bio:
Ms. Shobhana Takiar is a highly accomplished legal professional having a distinguished career that spans nearly four decades. Since commencing her legal practice in 1988, she has established a robust reputation for handling high-stakes litigation, advisory work, and complex dispute resolution across multiple legal domains.

Her legal acumen has made her a highly trusted choice for major public institutions and regulatory bodies. She serves as a vital Standing Counsel for the Delhi Development Authority (DDA), actively defending the authority in complex land disputes, town planning issues, and writ petitions. Additionally, she is empanelled with the National Housing Bank (NHB) and previously served the public sector as the Additional Standing Counsel for the Government of NCT of Delhi (GNCTD), where she handled critical public interest and administrative civil matters.

Beyond her extensive public sector portfolio, Ms. Takiar maintains a powerful private practice footprint, representing prominent corporate brands such as PVR Cinemas and premium heritage names like Neemrana Hotels. Her versatile corporate and commercial practice spans a wide array of civil disciplines, with specialized expertise in Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act (RERA) compliance, land revenue disputes, contractual litigation, company law, and tender disputes.

name: Ms. Mukta Sharma
title: Senior Consultant
bio:
With over 36 years of distinguished legal practice, Ms. Mukta Sharma is a seasoned litigator and advisor known for delivering comprehensive, tailored legal solutions across a vast spectrum of civil and constitutional domains. Her career is anchored on a client-centric philosophy, combining deep analytical acumen with an unwavering commitment to strategic dispute resolution.

Ms. Sharma commenced her legal career in 1988 under the prestigious mentorship of Mrs. Shobha Dikshit (eminent Supreme Court Advocate and former Judge of the Allahabad High Court). During her foundational years, she gained rigorous exposure to high-stakes civil, criminal, tax, service, and constitutional matters, alongside assisting Mr. Anil Dev Singh, Senior Advocate (Retd. Chief Justice, Rajasthan High Court).

Ms. Sharma operates at the intersection of complex litigation and alternative dispute resolution, specializing in Property & Real Estate Law, Arbitration & Mediation, Service, Labour & Employment, and Co-operative Societies & Banking.

name: Mr. Shantwanu Singh, AoR
title: Consultant
education: LL.M. in International Trade and Commercial Law, Durham University (England)
Enrolled with the Bar Council of India (2011)
experience: 13+ years before the Supreme Court, High Courts and tribunals
bio:
Mr. Shantwanu Singh got enrolled with the Bar Council of India in the year 2011, and thereafter pursued his LL.M. in International Trade and Commercial Law from Durham University (England). After his return, he has been practising in the Supreme Court, different High Courts and tribunals.

He successfully qualified the Advocate-on-Record Examination conducted by the Supreme Court of India in the year 2018 and was appointed as Special Public Prosecutor by Delhi Police in the Delhi Riots Case. He has been retained by several prestigious companies like the Sahara Group of Companies and Oil India Ltd, along with various real estate companies. He has also been engaged as Legal Consultant by companies like Kajima India Pvt. Ltd., Godrej, BCC Infrastructures, B.C.C Precast, J.K.G Constructions, M.R Proview, MRJV and many others.

He has to his credit the opportunity of appearing in several high-profile cases under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, the National Security Act etc. before the Supreme Court and High Courts.

name: Ms. Shrishti Garg, C.A.
title: Consultant
experience: 10+ years across financial and insolvency domains
bio:
Ms. Shrishti Garg is a Chartered Accountant, a Registered Valuer, and an Insolvency Professional (2025), with over a decade of diverse experience across financial and insolvency domains.

She has been actively involved in managing and advising on more than 30 assignments, including Corporate Insolvency Resolution Processes (CIRP), Liquidation, and Voluntary Liquidation. Her expertise lies in stakeholder coordination, process management, and maximizing value in stressed situations.

Prior to her specialization in insolvency, she worked extensively in taxation, auditing, and assurance, building a strong foundation in financial reporting, compliance, and audit practices. She brings a structured and solution-oriented approach to complex engagements and is known for her collaborative style, adaptability, and ability to bring fresh perspectives to challenging situations.

name: Ms. Seema Jangid, CS
title: Consultant
experience: 9+ years in corporate legal affairs and compliance
bio:
Ms. Seema Jangid is a qualified Company Secretary and legal professional with over 9 years of experience in corporate legal affairs, contract management, corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and secretarial functions.

She possesses extensive experience in advising businesses on legal and regulatory matters, drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, managing board and shareholder processes, and ensuring compliance with corporate laws.

name: Mr. Lakshay Narang
title: Domain Expert - Fintech & Strategy
education: Specialization in Business Management & Financial Technology
experience: 10+ years in Fintech, Business Management & Strategic Networking
bio:
Mr. Lakshay Narang is a distinguished domain expert in Financial Technology (Fintech), Business Management, and Strategic Enterprise Networking. With extensive experience across dynamic business sectors, Mr. Narang specializes in guiding enterprises through digital financial transformation, strategic business scaling, and high-impact partnership development.

He possesses deep-seated expertise in fintech ecosystems, regulatory alignment for digital financial products, and business management operations. His proficiency in corporate networking and stakeholder engagement enables organizations to establish strategic alliances, streamline operational workflows, and capitalize on emerging market opportunities.

Known for his versatile domain knowledge and strategic vision, Mr. Narang provides invaluable business and financial technology counsel to corporate clients, startups, and institutional stakeholders across diverse industry verticals.

name: Mr. Rakshit Jain
title: Counsel
education: Professional Qualification in Finance and Taxation
experience: 12+ years in Audit, Banking, Finance and Taxation
bio: Mr. Rakshit Jain is a well qualified professional with over 12 years of experience in the field of Audit, Banking, Finance and Direct & Indirect Taxation. Given his effective liaison skills, he has an impressive track record of successfully coordinating with Government organizations in various matters.

name: Mr. Trivesh Mehlawat
title: Senior Associate
experience: Extensive experience in civil litigation and dispute resolution
bio:
Mr. Trivesh Mehlawat, a practicing advocate, has immense experience in the field of Civil Litigation & Dispute Resolution and specializes in IPR with a focus on trademarks.

He has immense experience and a good success rate in securing Bail and Anticipatory Bail for clients.

name: Mr. Shubhankar Sharma
title: Team Lead
experience: 10+ years in litigation and regulatory compliance
bio:
Mr. Shubhankar Sharma, a practicing advocate, has immense experience in the field of Litigation & Dispute Resolution.

He has also worked extensively with the Food & Beverage industry, Hospitality & Tourism businesses and Education Companies, advising them on company incorporation, statutory registrations including FSSAI and Weights and Measures, Real Estate, Compliances and other documentation.

name: Mr. Udayan Khandelwal
title: Partner
education: Member, Delhi High Court Bar Association
experience: 15+ years in litigation and dispute resolution
bio:
Mr. Udayan Khandelwal is a distinguished practicing Advocate with an established track record of successfully representing high-net-worth individuals and corporate clients across India's diverse judicial and quasi-judicial landscape. Known for his analytical precision and result-oriented approach, Mr. Khandelwal excels at strategizing complex litigation to deliver favourable, high-stakes outcomes for his clients.

His expansive litigation and dispute resolution practice is heavily anchored in the field of Arbitration. He brings profound experience to handling intricate Arbitral Claims, robust Defences, and critical petitions under Sections 9, 11, 14, 15, 34, and 37 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act. Beyond alternative dispute resolution, his courtroom mastery spans comprehensive Civil and Commercial Litigation, white-collar matters involving Economic Offences and Anti-Corruption Laws, and complex corporate interventions under Competition Law and Insolvency & Bankruptcy frameworks.

Recognizing that modern enterprise and personal wealth require adaptive legal safeguards, Mr. Khandelwal also maintains a forward-looking practice that services dynamic market sectors and private clients. He regularly advises on the structuring and enforcement of commercial Contracts, Consumer Laws, and modern digital compliance frameworks covering E-Commerce and Privacy regulations. Additionally, he provides trusted counsel to individuals navigating sensitive personal asset management through tailored Wills & Estate Planning.

As an active and respected member of the legal community, Mr. Khandelwal is enrolled with the Bar Council of Delhi and is a member of the Delhi High Court Bar Association, continuously contributing to the highest standards of advocacy and legal strategy across various courts and tribunals nationwide.

name: Mr. Rahul Dubey, LL.M. (UCL, London)
title: Partner
education: LL.M. in Intellectual Property Law, University College London (UCL)
experience: 10+ years across commercial, civil and criminal law
bio:
Mr. Rahul Dubey is a versatile litigator with over a decade of experience spanning commercial, civil, and criminal law. He has developed deep expertise in litigation and arbitration, with a strong focus on intellectual property rights, including trademark, copyright, patent, and design infringement. He frequently appears before the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India, the Hon'ble Delhi High Court, and various trial courts.

Rahul holds an LL.M. in Intellectual Property Law from University College London (UCL) and has a strong academic and practical grounding in dispute resolution under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, contractual matters, and complex civil suits. In addition to litigation, he is adept in conveyancing and rendering legal opinions, particularly in matters involving IPR.

A published author and speaker at national and international legal forums, Rahul actively contributes to thought leadership in emerging legal issues. He is a member of the Delhi High Court Bar Association and serves as a panel lawyer for GAIL and SBI, amongst other entities.
publications: Arbitrability of IPR disputes (Satyam International Publication, ISBN: 978-93-91345-11-2)
IPR and Artificial Intelligence (University of Helsinki)
